```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# 设置报告运行环境，并加载流程共用函数。
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
# 从 Rmd 文件位置或工作目录定位 pipeline 根（兼容 render 与交互运行，不依赖 .git/.Rproj）。
input_dir <- tryCatch(
  dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), mustWork = FALSE)),
  error = function(e) ""
)
root_candidates <- unique(normalizePath(
  c(input_dir, getwd(), file.path(getwd(), "snRNAseq_publication_pipeline")),
  mustWork = FALSE
))
pipeline_root <- root_candidates[
  file.exists(file.path(root_candidates, "R", "pipeline_helpers.R"))
][1]
if (is.na(pipeline_root)) {
  stop("Cannot locate the pipeline root containing R/pipeline_helpers.R", call. = FALSE)
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = pipeline_root)
source(file.path(pipeline_root, "R", "pipeline_helpers.R"))
# gate 聚类路径与 run_gate_evidence.R 共用（gate_definitions / 共享聚类函数）。
source(file.path(pipeline_root, "R", "gate_cluster_helpers.R"))
```

## Configuration

```{r libraries}
# 从集中参数文件读取聚类、注释和 marker panel 参数。
source(file.path(pipeline_root, "config", "pipeline_params.R"))

# 检查并加载骨髓聚类、SingleR 注释和绘图所需包。
check_packages(c(
  "Seurat", "SeuratObject", "SingleR", "celldex", "scuttle",
  "BiocParallel", "harmony", "dplyr", "ggplot2",
  "patchwork", "future", "glmGamPoi", "here"
))

library(Seurat)
library(SingleR)
library(celldex)
library(scuttle)
library(BiocParallel)
library(harmony)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(future)

if (requireNamespace("RhpcBLASctl", quietly = TRUE)) {
  RhpcBLASctl::blas_set_num_threads(1)
  RhpcBLASctl::omp_set_num_threads(1)
}

# 固定随机种子，保证聚类编号可复现（agent 注释 gate 的证据脚本依赖此一致性）。
set.seed(seed)

# Seurat uses the future backend in expensive steps such as SCTransform.
plan("multicore", workers = n_workers)
options(future.fork.enable = TRUE)
options(future.globals.maxSize = future_globals_maxsize)

paths <- get_pipeline_paths(project_root = dirname(pipeline_root))
fig_dir <- ensure_dir(file.path(paths$fig_dir, "02_BM_Annotation"))
table_dir <- ensure_dir(file.path(paths$table_dir, "02_BM_Annotation"))
# 本脚本 gate（骨髓 B lineage）的登记表：lineage 正则与 map 文件以 gate_definitions 为准。
gate_defs <- gate_definitions()

# 聚类维度、分辨率、Harmony 设置与 marker panel 统一由 config/pipeline_params.R 定义。
```

## Load bone marrow object

```{r load}
# 读取 00 步骤输出的骨髓 QC 后对象。
sc_bm <- readRDS(file.path(paths$rds_dir, "00_bonemarrow_qc.rds"))
sc_bm$Group <- normalize_group_levels(sc_bm$Group)
message("Bone marrow cells after QC: ", ncol(sc_bm))
```

## Main clustering without sample-level Harmony

```{r main_clustering}
# 主聚类 + SingleR 主注释走 gate_cluster_helpers.R 的共享函数，
# 与 run_gate_evidence.R 严格同一路径（cluster 编号一致的前提）。
ref_immgen <- celldex::ImmGenData()
sc_bm <- run_main_clustering_annotation(
  sc_bm,
  ref = ref_immgen,
  dims = dims_main,
  resolution = cluster_res_main,
  harmony_batch_var = harmony_batch_var,
  workers = n_workers
)

p_clusters <- DimPlot(sc_bm, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", split.by = "Group", pt.size = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Bone marrow clusters")
print(p_clusters)
# 保存主聚类 UMAP，供后续检查聚类结构。
save_pub_plot(p_clusters, "02_bm_umap_clusters", fig_dir, width = 10, height = 5)
```

## SingleR main annotation

```{r singler}
# SingleR 主类别注释结果可视化（注释计算已在上一步共享函数内完成）。
p_main <- DimPlot(sc_bm, reduction = "umap", group.by = "CellType_Main", split.by = "Group", pt.size = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Bone marrow main annotation")
print(p_main)
save_pub_plot(p_main, "02_bm_umap_main_annotation", fig_dir, width = 11, height = 6)

main_table <- sc_bm@meta.data |>
  dplyr::count(Group, MouseID, CellType_Main, name = "Cells")
# 输出主类别在每只 mouse 中的细胞数。
write.csv(main_table, file.path(table_dir, "02_bm_main_annotation_counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Refine B lineage and plasma cell-like compartment

```{r blineage_refinement}
# 筛选 B lineage 和 plasma 相关标签，进入骨髓 B lineage 精细聚类。
# 筛选正则与 lineage 名取自 gate_definitions（与证据脚本同一定义处）。
b_bm <- prepare_lineage_compartment(
  sc_bm,
  label_pattern = gate_defs[["02_blineage"]]$label_pattern,
  dims = dims_subset,
  resolution = cluster_res_bm_subset,
  harmony_batch_var = harmony_batch_var,
  min_cells = min_cells_for_refinement,
  lineage_label = gate_defs[["02_blineage"]]$lineage
)

bm_map_path <- file.path(paths$map_dir, gate_defs[["02_blineage"]]$map_file)
bm_template_path <- file.path(table_dir, "02_bm_blineage_annotation_template_current_clusters.csv")
# 写模板并校验手动注释表；未覆盖时写 gate 状态文件并以 GATE[02_blineage] 前缀停止。
bm_map_check <- check_annotation_gate(
  b_bm, bm_map_path,
  gate_id = "02_blineage",
  template_path = bm_template_path,
  status_dir = paths$gate_dir
)
b_bm <- apply_manual_annotation(b_bm, bm_map_check$map, unknown_label = "Unknown bone marrow B-lineage cluster")

# 骨髓 B lineage marker panel 由 config/pipeline_params.R 提供，用于验证 pro/pre、成熟 B、浆母和浆细胞样标签。

p_bm_clusters <- DimPlot(b_bm, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", split.by = "Group", pt.size = 0.35) +
  labs(title = "Bone marrow B-lineage subclusters")
p_bm_anno <- DimPlot(b_bm, reduction = "umap", group.by = "CellType_Fine", split.by = "Group", pt.size = 0.35) +
  labs(title = "Bone marrow B-lineage manual annotation")
p_bm_dot <- make_marker_dotplot(b_bm, bm_blineage_markers, group.by = "CellType_Fine", title = "Bone marrow B-lineage marker validation")

print(p_bm_clusters)
print(p_bm_anno)
print(p_bm_dot)

save_pub_plot(p_bm_clusters, "02_bm_blineage_umap_clusters", fig_dir, width = 10, height = 5)
save_pub_plot(p_bm_anno, "02_bm_blineage_umap_manual_annotation", fig_dir, width = 11, height = 6)
save_pub_plot(p_bm_dot, "02_bm_blineage_marker_dotplot", fig_dir, width = 10, height = 5)

# 同时按 cluster 和最终 fine label 输出 marker 表达验证表。
bm_validation_cluster <- marker_validation_table(b_bm, bm_blineage_markers, group_col = "seurat_clusters")
bm_validation_fine <- marker_validation_table(b_bm, bm_blineage_markers, group_col = "CellType_Fine")
write.csv(bm_validation_cluster, file.path(table_dir, "02_bm_blineage_marker_validation_by_cluster.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bm_validation_fine, file.path(table_dir, "02_bm_blineage_marker_validation_by_fine_label.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Merge refined labels back to bone marrow

```{r merge_back}
# 将 B lineage 子聚类的精细标签写回完整骨髓对象。
sc_bm$CellType_Fine <- sc_bm$CellType_Main
sc_bm$CellType_Fine[colnames(b_bm)] <- b_bm$CellType_Fine

p_fine <- DimPlot(sc_bm, reduction = "umap", group.by = "CellType_Fine", split.by = "Group", pt.size = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Bone marrow fine annotation")
print(p_fine)
save_pub_plot(p_fine, "02_bm_umap_fine_annotation", fig_dir, width = 12, height = 6)

fine_table <- sc_bm@meta.data |>
  dplyr::count(Group, MouseID, CellType_Fine, name = "Cells")
# 保存最终 fine annotation 计数和后续步骤使用的 RDS 对象。
write.csv(fine_table, file.path(table_dir, "02_bm_fine_annotation_counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(sc_bm, file.path(paths$rds_dir, "02_bonemarrow_annotated.rds"))
saveRDS(b_bm, file.path(paths$rds_dir, "02_bm_blineage_refined.rds"))
```
